import unittest
import numpy as np
from core.global_game_state import GlobalGameState
from core.allied_armies import (
    US_FIRST_ARMY,
    BRITISH_SECOND_ARMY,
    CANADIAN_FIRST_ARMY,
    US_THIRD_ARMY,
    US_VIII_CORPS,
    US_XV_CORPS,
)
from core.map.map_spaces_us_1 import (
    us_1_track,
)
from core.map.map_spaces_brit_2 import (
    brit_2_track,
)
from core.map.map_spaces_can_1 import (
    can_1_track,
)
from core.map.map_spaces_us_3 import (
    us_viii_track,
    us_xv_track,
)
from core.ai.dqn.dqn_game_state_encoder import (
    OBSERVATION_SIZE,
    ALLIED_ARMIES_START,
    ALLIED_ARMIES_END,
    ALLIED_FEATURES_PER_ARMY,
    US_THIRD_ACTIVATED_INDEX,
    US_THIRD_MERGED_INDEX,
    ARMIES_UPGRADED_INDEX,
    encode_allied_armies,
)
class TestEncodeAlliedArmies(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.armies = [
            US_FIRST_ARMY,
            BRITISH_SECOND_ARMY,
            CANADIAN_FIRST_ARMY,
            US_THIRD_ARMY,
            US_VIII_CORPS,
            US_XV_CORPS,
        ]
        for army in self.armies:
            army.location = None
            army.flipped = False
            army.merged = False
        GlobalGameState.counter_attacked_armies = set()
        GlobalGameState.us_third_army_activated = False
        GlobalGameState.us_third_army_merged = False
        GlobalGameState.armies_upgraded = False
        self.observation = np.zeros(
            OBSERVATION_SIZE,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_inactive_army(self):
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        us_first_start = ALLIED_ARMIES_START
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[us_first_start],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[us_first_start + 1],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[us_first_start + 2],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[us_first_start + 3],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_active_army(self):
        US_FIRST_ARMY.location = us_1_track[0]
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        us_first_start = ALLIED_ARMIES_START
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[us_first_start + 1],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_progress_start(self):
        US_FIRST_ARMY.location = us_1_track[0]
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        us_first_start = ALLIED_ARMIES_START
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[us_first_start],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_progress_end(self):
        US_FIRST_ARMY.location = us_1_track[-1]
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        us_first_start = ALLIED_ARMIES_START
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[us_first_start],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_progress_middle(self):
        middle_index = len(us_1_track) // 2
        US_FIRST_ARMY.location = us_1_track[middle_index]
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        expected_progress = (
            middle_index / (len(us_1_track) - 1)
        )
        us_first_start = ALLIED_ARMIES_START
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[us_first_start],
            expected_progress,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_flipped(self):
        US_FIRST_ARMY.location = us_1_track[0]
        US_FIRST_ARMY.flipped = True
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        us_first_start = ALLIED_ARMIES_START
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[us_first_start + 2],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_counterattacked(self):
        US_FIRST_ARMY.location = us_1_track[0]
        GlobalGameState.counter_attacked_armies = {
            US_FIRST_ARMY.name
        }
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        us_first_start = ALLIED_ARMIES_START
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[us_first_start + 3],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_each_army_uses_correct_block(self):
        army_tracks = [
            (US_FIRST_ARMY, us_1_track),
            (BRITISH_SECOND_ARMY, brit_2_track),
            (CANADIAN_FIRST_ARMY, can_1_track),
            (US_THIRD_ARMY, us_xv_track),
            (US_VIII_CORPS, us_viii_track),
            (US_XV_CORPS, us_xv_track),
        ]
        for army, track in army_tracks:
            army.location = track[-1]
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        for army_index in range(6):
            start = (
                ALLIED_ARMIES_START
                + army_index * ALLIED_FEATURES_PER_ARMY
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                self.observation[start],
                1.0,
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                self.observation[start + 1],
                1.0,
            )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_us_third_activated(self):
        GlobalGameState.us_third_army_activated = True
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[US_THIRD_ACTIVATED_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_us_third_merged(self):
        GlobalGameState.us_third_army_merged = True
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[US_THIRD_MERGED_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_armies_upgraded(self):
        GlobalGameState.armies_upgraded = True
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[ARMIES_UPGRADED_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_global_flags_false(self):
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[US_THIRD_ACTIVATED_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[US_THIRD_MERGED_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[ARMIES_UPGRADED_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_allied_armies_only_changes_allied_block(self):
        US_FIRST_ARMY.location = us_1_track[-1]
        BRITISH_SECOND_ARMY.location = brit_2_track[-1]
        CANADIAN_FIRST_ARMY.location = can_1_track[-1]
        GlobalGameState.us_third_army_activated = True
        GlobalGameState.armies_upgraded = True
        encode_allied_armies(self.observation)
        before_allied = self.observation[:ALLIED_ARMIES_START]
        after_allied = self.observation[ALLIED_ARMIES_END:]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(before_allied),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(after_allied),
            0,
        )
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
import numpy as np
from cards.card_10 import card as card_010

    DRAWN_CARDS_END,

    LATE_DECK_ADDED_INDEX,
    encode_campaign_state,
    print_observation_summary,
)
class TestEncodeCampaignState(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        GlobalGameState.cards_drawn = 0
        GlobalGameState.current_card = None
        GlobalGameState.drawn_cards = []
        GlobalGameState.mid_deck_added = False
        GlobalGameState.late_deck_added = False
        self.observation = np.zeros(
            OBSERVATION_SIZE,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
    def test_encode_campaign_state_initial_state(self):

        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[CARDS_DRAWN_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertTrue(
            np.all(
                self.observation[
                    CURRENT_CARD_START:CURRENT_CARD_END
                ] == 0.0
            )
        )
        self.assertTrue(
            np.all(
                self.observation[
                    DRAWN_CARDS_START:DRAWN_CARDS_END
                ] == 0.0
            )
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[MID_DECK_ADDED_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[LATE_DECK_ADDED_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_campaign_state_cards_drawn(self):
        GlobalGameState.cards_drawn = 24
        encode_campaign_state(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[CARDS_DRAWN_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
        print_observation_summary(self.observation)
    def test_encode_campaign_state_current_card(self):
        GlobalGameState.current_card = card_020
        encode_campaign_state(self.observation)
        current_card_state = self.observation[
            CURRENT_CARD_START:CURRENT_CARD_END
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(current_card_state),
            1,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                CURRENT_CARD_START + 19
            ],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_campaign_state_drawn_cards(self):
        GlobalGameState.drawn_cards = [
            card_010,
            card_020,
            card_030,
        ]
        encode_campaign_state(self.observation)
        drawn_card_state = self.observation[
            DRAWN_CARDS_START:DRAWN_CARDS_END
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(drawn_card_state),
            3,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                DRAWN_CARDS_START + 9
            ],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                DRAWN_CARDS_START + 19
            ],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                DRAWN_CARDS_START + 29
            ],
            1.0,
        )

        encode_campaign_state(self.observation)

                    space.units.remove(commander)
        for box in [
            in_transit_box,
            strategic_reserve_box,
            eliminated_units_box,
        ]:
            for commander in self.commanders:
                if commander in box.units:
                    box.units.remove(commander)

        GlobalGameState.model_in_command = False

        )

            self.observation[

            1.0,
        )

        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                MEYER_START + carentan_location_index
            ],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                MODEL_START + bayeux_location_index
            ],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_commanders_each_commander_has_one_location(self):
        encode_commanders(self.observation)
        for start_index in [
            ROMMEL_START,
            MEYER_START,
            MODEL_START,
        ]:
            location_state = self.observation[
                start_index:
                start_index + NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT
            ]
            self.assertEqual(
                np.count_nonzero(location_state),
                1,
            )
    def test_encode_commanders_flags_independent_of_locations(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(MEYER)
        in_transit_box.units.append(MODEL)
        GlobalGameState.meyer_available = True
        GlobalGameState.model_in_command = True
        encode_commanders(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                MEYER_START + LOCATION_STRATEGIC_RESERVE
            ],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                MODEL_START + LOCATION_IN_TRANSIT
            ],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[MEYER_AVAILABLE_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[MODEL_IN_COMMAND_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_commanders_only_changes_commanders_block(self):
        in_transit_box.units.append(ROMMEL)
        carentan.units.append(MEYER)
        bayeux.units.append(MODEL)
        GlobalGameState.meyer_available = True
        GlobalGameState.model_in_command = True
        encode_commanders(self.observation)
        before_commanders = self.observation[:COMMANDERS_START]
        after_commanders = self.observation[COMMANDERS_END:]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(before_commanders),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(after_commanders),
            0,
        )
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

            context,

                self.observation[

            ),
            0,

        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(
                self.observation[
                    DECISION_CONTEXT_END:
                ]
            ),
            0,
        )

import unittest
import numpy as np
from core.global_game_state import GlobalGameState
from core.map.map_utilities import do_opening_setup
from core.ai.dqn.dqn_game_state_encoder import (
    OBSERVATION_SIZE,
    DRM_START,
    DRM_END,
    TRANSPORT_ROLL_DRM_INDEX,
    SUPPLY_ROLL_DRM_INDEX,
    TRANSPORT_CHECK_DRM_INDEX,
    SUPPLY_CHECK_DRM_INDEX,
    HITLER_APPROVAL_CHECK_DRM_INDEX,
    MIN_TRANSPORT_ROLL_DRM,
    MAX_TRANSPORT_ROLL_DRM,
    MIN_SUPPLY_ROLL_DRM,
    MAX_SUPPLY_ROLL_DRM,
    MIN_TRANSPORT_CHECK_DRM,
    MAX_TRANSPORT_CHECK_DRM,
    MIN_SUPPLY_CHECK_DRM,
    MAX_SUPPLY_CHECK_DRM,
    MIN_HITLER_APPROVAL_CHECK_DRM,
    MAX_HITLER_APPROVAL_CHECK_DRM,
    encode_drms,
)
class TestEncodeDrms(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        do_opening_setup()
        self.observation = np.zeros(
            OBSERVATION_SIZE,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
    def test_encode_drms_opening_setup(self):
        encode_drms(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[TRANSPORT_ROLL_DRM_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[SUPPLY_ROLL_DRM_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[TRANSPORT_CHECK_DRM_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[SUPPLY_CHECK_DRM_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_APPROVAL_CHECK_DRM_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
    def test_encode_drms_minimum_values(self):
        GlobalGameState.transport_roll_drm = MIN_TRANSPORT_ROLL_DRM
        GlobalGameState.supply_roll_drm = MIN_SUPPLY_ROLL_DRM
        GlobalGameState.transport_check_drm = MIN_TRANSPORT_CHECK_DRM
        GlobalGameState.supply_check_drm = MIN_SUPPLY_CHECK_DRM
        GlobalGameState.hitler_approval_check_drm = (
            MIN_HITLER_APPROVAL_CHECK_DRM
        )
        encode_drms(self.observation)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(
            self.observation[DRM_START:DRM_END],
            np.zeros(5),
        )
    def test_encode_drms_maximum_values(self):
        GlobalGameState.transport_roll_drm = MAX_TRANSPORT_ROLL_DRM
        GlobalGameState.supply_roll_drm = MAX_SUPPLY_ROLL_DRM
        GlobalGameState.transport_check_drm = MAX_TRANSPORT_CHECK_DRM
        GlobalGameState.supply_check_drm = MAX_SUPPLY_CHECK_DRM
        GlobalGameState.hitler_approval_check_drm = (
            MAX_HITLER_APPROVAL_CHECK_DRM
        )
        encode_drms(self.observation)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(
            self.observation[DRM_START:DRM_END],
            np.ones(5),
        )
    def test_encode_drms_individual_positions(self):
        GlobalGameState.transport_roll_drm = MAX_TRANSPORT_ROLL_DRM
        GlobalGameState.supply_roll_drm = MIN_SUPPLY_ROLL_DRM
        GlobalGameState.transport_check_drm = MAX_TRANSPORT_CHECK_DRM
        GlobalGameState.supply_check_drm = MIN_SUPPLY_CHECK_DRM
        GlobalGameState.hitler_approval_check_drm = (
            MAX_HITLER_APPROVAL_CHECK_DRM
        )
        encode_drms(self.observation)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(
            self.observation[DRM_START:DRM_END],
            [
                1.0,
                0.0,
                1.0,
                0.0,
                1.0,
            ],
        )
    def test_encode_drms_zero_is_midpoint(self):
        GlobalGameState.transport_roll_drm = 0
        GlobalGameState.supply_roll_drm = 0
        GlobalGameState.transport_check_drm = 0
        GlobalGameState.supply_check_drm = 0
        GlobalGameState.hitler_approval_check_drm = 0
        encode_drms(self.observation)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(
            self.observation[DRM_START:DRM_END],
            np.full(5, 0.5),
        )
    def test_encode_drms_values_are_independent(self):
        GlobalGameState.transport_roll_drm = -3
        GlobalGameState.supply_roll_drm = -2
        GlobalGameState.transport_check_drm = 0
        GlobalGameState.supply_check_drm = 2
        GlobalGameState.hitler_approval_check_drm = 3
        encode_drms(self.observation)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(
            self.observation[DRM_START:DRM_END],
            [
                0.0,
                1 / 6,
                0.5,
                5 / 6,
                1.0,
            ],
        )
    def test_encode_drms_only_changes_drm_block(self):
        GlobalGameState.transport_roll_drm = 3
        GlobalGameState.supply_roll_drm = -3
        GlobalGameState.transport_check_drm = 1
        GlobalGameState.supply_check_drm = -1
        GlobalGameState.hitler_approval_check_drm = 2
        encode_drms(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(
                self.observation[:DRM_START]
            ),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(
                self.observation[DRM_END:]
            ),
            0,
        )
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
import numpy as np
from core.map.map_utilities import do_opening_setup
from core.ai.headless_action_masks import HeadlessDecisionState
from core.ai.dqn.dqn_game_state_encoder import (
    OBSERVATION_SIZE,
    DECISION_ACTION_PHASE_INDEX,
    DECISION_ARMY_START,
    DECISION_ALLIED_ATTACK_INDEX,
    DecisionType,
    DecisionContext,
    US_FIRST_ARMY,
    encode_game_state,
)
class TestEncodeGameState(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        do_opening_setup()
        HeadlessDecisionState.reset_hitler_intervention()
    def tearDown(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.reset_hitler_intervention()
    def test_encode_complete_opening_game_state(self):
        observation = encode_game_state()
        self.assertEqual(
            observation.shape,
            (OBSERVATION_SIZE,),
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            observation.dtype,
            np.float32,
        )
        self.assertTrue(
            np.all(np.isfinite(observation))
        )
        self.assertTrue(
            np.all(observation >= 0.0)
        )
        self.assertTrue(
            np.all(observation <= 1.0)
        )
        self.assertGreater(
            np.count_nonzero(observation),
            0,
        )
    def test_encode_complete_game_state_with_decision_context(self):
        context = DecisionContext(
            decision_type=DecisionType.ACTION_PHASE,
            relevant_army=US_FIRST_ARMY,
            allied_attack=True,
        )
        observation = encode_game_state(context)
        self.assertEqual(
            observation[DECISION_ACTION_PHASE_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            observation[DECISION_ARMY_START],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            observation[DECISION_ALLIED_ATTACK_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_game_state_returns_fresh_observation(self):
        first_observation = encode_game_state()
        second_observation = encode_game_state()
        self.assertIsNot(
            first_observation,
            second_observation,
        )
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(
            first_observation,
            second_observation,
        )
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
import numpy as np
from core.models import GermanUnit
from core.enums import ReinforcementType
from core.map.map_model import (
    strategic_reserve_box,
    eliminated_units_box,
)
from core.ai.dqn.dqn_game_state_encoder import (
    OBSERVATION_SIZE,
    GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START,
    GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_END,
    GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_BOX,
    MAX_TOTAL_FLAK,
    MAX_TOTAL_KAMPFGRUPPE,
    MAX_TOTAL_NEBELWERFER,
    encode_generic_box_units,
)
class TestEncodeGenericBoxUnits(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        for box in [
            strategic_reserve_box,
            eliminated_units_box,
        ]:
            box.units[:] = [
                unit
                for unit in box.units
                if not (
                    isinstance(unit, GermanUnit)
                    and unit.type in {
                        ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                        ReinforcementType.KAMPFGRUPPE,
                        ReinforcementType.NEBELWERFER,
                    }
                )
            ]
        self.observation = np.zeros(
            OBSERVATION_SIZE,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_box_units_empty_boxes(self):
        encode_generic_box_units(self.observation)
        box_state = self.observation[
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START:
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_END
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(box_state),
            0,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_box_units_in_transit_slots_remain_zero(self):
        encode_generic_box_units(self.observation)
        in_transit_state = self.observation[
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START:
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START + GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_BOX
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(in_transit_state),
            0,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_box_units_strategic_reserve_full_flak(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=2,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_box_units(self.observation)
        start = (
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START
            + GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_BOX
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            1 / MAX_TOTAL_FLAK,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_box_units_strategic_reserve_reduced_flak(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_box_units(self.observation)
        start = (
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START
            + GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_BOX
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            1 / MAX_TOTAL_FLAK,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_box_units_strategic_reserve_kampfgruppe(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.KAMPFGRUPPE,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_box_units(self.observation)
        start = (
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START
            + GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_BOX
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 2],
            1 / MAX_TOTAL_KAMPFGRUPPE,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_box_units_strategic_reserve_nebelwerfer(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.NEBELWERFER,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_box_units(self.observation)
        start = (
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START
            + GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_BOX
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 3],
            1 / MAX_TOTAL_NEBELWERFER,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_box_units_strategic_reserve_mixed_counts(self):
        for _ in range(2):
            strategic_reserve_box.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                    combat_value=2,
                )
            )
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        for _ in range(3):
            strategic_reserve_box.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.KAMPFGRUPPE,
                    combat_value=1,
                )
            )
        for _ in range(2):
            strategic_reserve_box.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.NEBELWERFER,
                    combat_value=1,
                )
            )
        encode_generic_box_units(self.observation)
        start = (
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START
            + GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_BOX
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            2 / MAX_TOTAL_FLAK,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            1 / MAX_TOTAL_FLAK,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 2],
            3 / MAX_TOTAL_KAMPFGRUPPE,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 3],
            2 / MAX_TOTAL_NEBELWERFER,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_box_units_eliminated_mixed_counts(self):
        eliminated_units_box.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=2,
            )
        )
        eliminated_units_box.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        for _ in range(2):
            eliminated_units_box.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.KAMPFGRUPPE,
                    combat_value=1,
                )
            )
        for _ in range(3):
            eliminated_units_box.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.NEBELWERFER,
                    combat_value=1,
                )
            )
        encode_generic_box_units(self.observation)
        start = (
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START
            + 2 * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_BOX
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            1 / MAX_TOTAL_FLAK,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            1 / MAX_TOTAL_FLAK,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 2],
            2 / MAX_TOTAL_KAMPFGRUPPE,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 3],
            3 / MAX_TOTAL_NEBELWERFER,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_box_units_reserve_and_eliminated_are_independent(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=2,
            )
        )
        eliminated_units_box.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.NEBELWERFER,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_box_units(self.observation)
        reserve_start = (
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START
            + GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_BOX
        )
        eliminated_start = (
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START
            + 2 * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_BOX
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[reserve_start],
            1 / MAX_TOTAL_FLAK,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[reserve_start + 3],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[eliminated_start],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[eliminated_start + 3],
            1 / MAX_TOTAL_NEBELWERFER,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_box_units_only_changes_generic_box_block(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.KAMPFGRUPPE,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        eliminated_units_box.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.NEBELWERFER,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_box_units(self.observation)
        before_block = self.observation[
            :GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_START
        ]
        after_block = self.observation[
            GENERIC_BOX_UNITS_END:
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(before_block),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(after_block),
            0,
        )
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
import numpy as np
from core.models import GermanUnit
from core.enums import ReinforcementType
from core.map.map_spaces_brit_2 import bayeux
from core.map.map_spaces_us_1 import carentan
from core.ai.dqn.dqn_game_state_encoder import (
    OBSERVATION_SIZE,
    GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START,
    GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_END,
    GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE,
    GERMAN_MAP_SPACES,
    MAX_FLAK_STACK,
    MAX_KAMPFGRUPPE_STACK,
    MAX_NEBELWERFER_STACK,
    encode_generic_map_units,
)
class TestEncodeGenericMapUnits(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        for space in GERMAN_MAP_SPACES:
            space.units[:] = [
                unit
                for unit in space.units
                if not (
                    isinstance(unit, GermanUnit)
                    and unit.type in {
                        ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                        ReinforcementType.KAMPFGRUPPE,
                        ReinforcementType.NEBELWERFER,
                    }
                )
            ]
        self.observation = np.zeros(
            OBSERVATION_SIZE,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_map_units_empty_space(self):
        encode_generic_map_units(self.observation)
        bayeux_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(bayeux)
        start = (
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
            + bayeux_index * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start + 2],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start + 3],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_map_units_full_flak(self):
        bayeux.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=2,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_map_units(self.observation)
        bayeux_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(bayeux)
        start = (
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
            + bayeux_index * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            1 / MAX_FLAK_STACK,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_map_units_reduced_flak(self):
        bayeux.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_map_units(self.observation)
        bayeux_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(bayeux)
        start = (
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
            + bayeux_index * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            1 / MAX_FLAK_STACK,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_map_units_full_and_reduced_flak_separate(self):
        bayeux.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=2,
            )
        )
        bayeux.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_map_units(self.observation)
        bayeux_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(bayeux)
        start = (
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
            + bayeux_index * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            1 / MAX_FLAK_STACK,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            1 / MAX_FLAK_STACK,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_map_units_kampfgruppe(self):
        bayeux.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.KAMPFGRUPPE,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_map_units(self.observation)
        bayeux_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(bayeux)
        start = (
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
            + bayeux_index * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 2],
            1 / MAX_KAMPFGRUPPE_STACK,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_map_units_nebelwerfer(self):
        bayeux.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.NEBELWERFER,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_map_units(self.observation)
        bayeux_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(bayeux)
        start = (
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
            + bayeux_index * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 3],
            1 / MAX_NEBELWERFER_STACK,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_map_units_normalizes_maximum_stacks(self):
        for _ in range(MAX_FLAK_STACK):
            bayeux.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                    combat_value=2,
                )
            )
        for _ in range(MAX_FLAK_STACK):
            bayeux.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                    combat_value=1,
                )
            )
        for _ in range(MAX_KAMPFGRUPPE_STACK):
            bayeux.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.KAMPFGRUPPE,
                    combat_value=1,
                )
            )
        for _ in range(MAX_NEBELWERFER_STACK):
            bayeux.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.NEBELWERFER,
                    combat_value=1,
                )
            )
        encode_generic_map_units(self.observation)
        bayeux_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(bayeux)
        start = (
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
            + bayeux_index * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start + 2],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start + 3],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_map_units_mixed_counts(self):
        for _ in range(2):
            bayeux.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                    combat_value=2,
                )
            )
        bayeux.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        for _ in range(3):
            bayeux.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.KAMPFGRUPPE,
                    combat_value=1,
                )
            )
        for _ in range(2):
            bayeux.units.append(
                GermanUnit(
                    type=ReinforcementType.NEBELWERFER,
                    combat_value=1,
                )
            )
        encode_generic_map_units(self.observation)
        bayeux_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(bayeux)
        start = (
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
            + bayeux_index * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            2 / 3,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            1 / 3,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 2],
            3 / 4,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 3],
            2 / 3,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_map_units_spaces_are_independent(self):
        bayeux.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=2,
            )
        )
        carentan.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.KAMPFGRUPPE,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_map_units(self.observation)
        bayeux_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(bayeux)
        carentan_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(carentan)
        bayeux_start = (
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
            + bayeux_index * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        )
        carentan_start = (
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
            + carentan_index * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[bayeux_start],
            1 / 3,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[bayeux_start + 2],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[carentan_start],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[carentan_start + 2],
            1 / 4,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_map_units_named_units_are_ignored(self):
        named_unit = GermanUnit(
            type=ReinforcementType.PZ_DIV,
            name="TEST PANZER",
            combat_value=2,
        )
        bayeux.units.append(named_unit)
        encode_generic_map_units(self.observation)
        bayeux_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(bayeux)
        start = (
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
            + bayeux_index * GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        )
        space_state = self.observation[
            start:
            start + GENERIC_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(space_state),
            0,
        )
    def test_encode_generic_map_units_only_changes_generic_map_block(self):
        bayeux.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.FLAK_88,
                combat_value=2,
            )
        )
        carentan.units.append(
            GermanUnit(
                type=ReinforcementType.NEBELWERFER,
                combat_value=1,
            )
        )
        encode_generic_map_units(self.observation)
        before_block = self.observation[
            :GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_START
        ]
        after_block = self.observation[
            GENERIC_MAP_UNITS_END:
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(before_block),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(after_block),
            0,
        )
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
import numpy as np
from core.global_game_state import GlobalGameState
from core.map.map_utilities import do_opening_setup
from core.ai.dqn.dqn_game_state_encoder import (
    OBSERVATION_SIZE,
    STRATEGIC_STATE_START,
    STRATEGIC_STATE_END,
    CHERBOURG_CAPTURED_INDEX,
    HITLER_ASSASSINATION_INDEX,
    HITLER_INTERVENTION_NO_EFFECT_INDEX,
    BOCAGE_DEFENSE_INDEX,
    US_FIRST_FURTHEST_ADVANCE_INDEX,
    CURRENT_CARPET_BOMBING_INDEX,
    MAX_BOCAGE_DEFENSE_MODIFIER,
    MAX_CARPET_BOMBING,
    encode_global_game_state,
)
class TestEncodeGlobalGameState(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        do_opening_setup()
        self.observation = np.zeros(
            OBSERVATION_SIZE,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_opening_setup(self):
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[CHERBOURG_CAPTURED_INDEX],
            float(GlobalGameState.cherbourg_captured),
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_ASSASSINATION_INDEX],
            float(GlobalGameState.hitler_assassination),
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_INTERVENTION_NO_EFFECT_INDEX],
            float(GlobalGameState.hitler_intervention_no_effect),
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[BOCAGE_DEFENSE_INDEX],
            GlobalGameState.bocage_defense_modifier
            / MAX_BOCAGE_DEFENSE_MODIFIER,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[US_FIRST_FURTHEST_ADVANCE_INDEX],
            (
                11
                - GlobalGameState.us_first_army_furthest_advance
            ) / 11,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[CURRENT_CARPET_BOMBING_INDEX],
            GlobalGameState.current_carpet_bombing
            / MAX_CARPET_BOMBING,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_cherbourg_captured(self):
        GlobalGameState.cherbourg_captured = True
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[CHERBOURG_CAPTURED_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_hitler_assassination(self):
        GlobalGameState.hitler_assassination = True
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_ASSASSINATION_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_hitler_intervention_no_effect(self):
        GlobalGameState.hitler_intervention_no_effect = True
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_INTERVENTION_NO_EFFECT_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_bocage_defense(self):
        GlobalGameState.bocage_defense_modifier = 1
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[BOCAGE_DEFENSE_INDEX],
            1 / MAX_BOCAGE_DEFENSE_MODIFIER,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_bocage_defense_maximum(self):
        GlobalGameState.bocage_defense_modifier = (
            MAX_BOCAGE_DEFENSE_MODIFIER
        )
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[BOCAGE_DEFENSE_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_us_first_furthest_advance_start(self):
        GlobalGameState.us_first_army_furthest_advance = 11
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[US_FIRST_FURTHEST_ADVANCE_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_us_first_furthest_advance_midway(self):
        GlobalGameState.us_first_army_furthest_advance = 6
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[US_FIRST_FURTHEST_ADVANCE_INDEX],
            5 / 11,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_us_first_furthest_advance_maximum(self):
        GlobalGameState.us_first_army_furthest_advance = 0
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[US_FIRST_FURTHEST_ADVANCE_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_carpet_bombing(self):
        GlobalGameState.current_carpet_bombing = 1
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[CURRENT_CARPET_BOMBING_INDEX],
            1 / MAX_CARPET_BOMBING,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_carpet_bombing_maximum(self):
        GlobalGameState.current_carpet_bombing = MAX_CARPET_BOMBING
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[CURRENT_CARPET_BOMBING_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_global_game_state_only_changes_its_block(self):
        GlobalGameState.cherbourg_captured = True
        GlobalGameState.hitler_assassination = True
        GlobalGameState.bocage_defense_modifier = 1
        GlobalGameState.current_carpet_bombing = 1
        encode_global_game_state(self.observation)
        before_block = self.observation[
            :STRATEGIC_STATE_START
        ]
        after_block = self.observation[
            STRATEGIC_STATE_END:
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(before_block),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(after_block),
            0,
        )
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
import numpy as np
from core.allied_armies import (
    US_FIRST_ARMY,
    BRITISH_SECOND_ARMY,
    CANADIAN_FIRST_ARMY,
    US_THIRD_ARMY,
    US_VIII_CORPS,
    US_XV_CORPS,
)
from core.ai.headless_action_masks import HeadlessDecisionState
from core.ai.dqn.dqn_game_state_encoder import (
    OBSERVATION_SIZE,
    HITLER_STATE_START,
    HITLER_STATE_END,
    HITLER_STAGE_NONE_INDEX,
    HITLER_STAGE_CANCEL_INDEX,
    HITLER_STAGE_TARGET_INDEX,
    HITLER_STAGE_REDEPLOY_INDEX,
    HITLER_TARGET_START,
    HITLER_TARGET_END,
    HITLER_REDEPLOYMENTS_INDEX,
    encode_hitler_intervention_state,
)
class TestEncodeHitlerInterventionState(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.reset_hitler_intervention()
        self.observation = np.zeros(
            OBSERVATION_SIZE,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
    def tearDown(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.reset_hitler_intervention()
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_initial_state(self):
        encode_hitler_intervention_state(
            self.observation
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_STAGE_NONE_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(
                self.observation[
                    HITLER_STAGE_NONE_INDEX:
                    HITLER_STAGE_REDEPLOY_INDEX + 1
                ]
            ),
            1,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(
                self.observation[
                    HITLER_TARGET_START:
                    HITLER_TARGET_END
                ]
            ),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_REDEPLOYMENTS_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_cancel_stage(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_stage = "CANCEL"
        encode_hitler_intervention_state(
            self.observation
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_STAGE_CANCEL_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(
                self.observation[
                    HITLER_STAGE_NONE_INDEX:
                    HITLER_STAGE_REDEPLOY_INDEX + 1
                ]
            ),
            1,
        )
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_target_stage(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_stage = "TARGET"
        encode_hitler_intervention_state(
            self.observation
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_STAGE_TARGET_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(
                self.observation[
                    HITLER_STAGE_NONE_INDEX:
                    HITLER_STAGE_REDEPLOY_INDEX + 1
                ]
            ),
            1,
        )
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_redeploy_stage(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_stage = "REDEPLOY"
        encode_hitler_intervention_state(
            self.observation
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_STAGE_REDEPLOY_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(
                self.observation[
                    HITLER_STAGE_NONE_INDEX:
                    HITLER_STAGE_REDEPLOY_INDEX + 1
                ]
            ),
            1,
        )
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_us_first_target(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_stage = "TARGET"
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_target = US_FIRST_ARMY
        encode_hitler_intervention_state(
            self.observation
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_TARGET_START],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(
                self.observation[
                    HITLER_TARGET_START:
                    HITLER_TARGET_END
                ]
            ),
            1,
        )
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_all_army_targets(self):
        armies = [
            US_FIRST_ARMY,
            BRITISH_SECOND_ARMY,
            CANADIAN_FIRST_ARMY,
            US_THIRD_ARMY,
            US_VIII_CORPS,
            US_XV_CORPS,
        ]
        for expected_offset, army in enumerate(armies):
            observation = np.zeros(
                OBSERVATION_SIZE,
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_target = army
            encode_hitler_intervention_state(
                observation
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                observation[
                    HITLER_TARGET_START + expected_offset
                ],
                1.0,
                msg=f"Incorrect target encoding for {army.name}",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                np.count_nonzero(
                    observation[
                        HITLER_TARGET_START:
                        HITLER_TARGET_END
                    ]
                ),
                1,
            )
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_zero_redeployments(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_redeployments = 0
        encode_hitler_intervention_state(
            self.observation
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_REDEPLOYMENTS_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_one_redeployment(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_redeployments = 1
        encode_hitler_intervention_state(
            self.observation
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_REDEPLOYMENTS_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_two_redeployments(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_redeployments = 2
        encode_hitler_intervention_state(
            self.observation
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_REDEPLOYMENTS_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_complete_redeploy_state(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_stage = "REDEPLOY"
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_target = BRITISH_SECOND_ARMY
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_redeployments = 1
        encode_hitler_intervention_state(
            self.observation
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_STAGE_REDEPLOY_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_TARGET_START + 1],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_REDEPLOYMENTS_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_invalid_stage_raises(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_stage = "INVALID"
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            encode_hitler_intervention_state(
                self.observation
            )
    def test_encode_hitler_intervention_only_changes_its_block(self):
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_stage = "REDEPLOY"
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_target = US_FIRST_ARMY
        HeadlessDecisionState.hitler_intervention_redeployments = 2
        encode_hitler_intervention_state(
            self.observation
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(
                self.observation[:HITLER_STATE_START]
            ),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(
                self.observation[HITLER_STATE_END:]
            ),
            0,
        )
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


============================================================
PATH: tests\ai\game_state_encoder\test_map_state.py
============================================================
import unittest
import numpy as np
from core.enums import SideType
from core.ai.dqn.dqn_game_state_encoder import (
    OBSERVATION_SIZE,
    MAP_STATE_START,
    MAP_STATE_END,
    MAP_FEATURES_PER_SPACE,
    GERMAN_MAP_SPACES,
    MAX_FORTIFIED_VILLAGE_MODIFIER,
    encode_map_state,
)
from core.map.map_utilities import do_opening_setup
class TestEncodeMapState(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        do_opening_setup()
        self.observation = np.zeros(
            OBSERVATION_SIZE,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
    def get_space_start(self, space):
        space_index = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES.index(space)
        return MAP_STATE_START + space_index * MAP_FEATURES_PER_SPACE
    def test_encode_map_state_opening_setup(self):
        encode_map_state(self.observation)
        for space in GERMAN_MAP_SPACES:
            start = self.get_space_start(space)
            self.assertEqual(
                self.observation[start],
                float(space.controlling_player == SideType.GERMAN),
                msg=f"Incorrect control state for {space.name}",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                self.observation[start + 1],
                float(space.under_siege),
                msg=f"Incorrect siege state for {space.name}",
            )
            self.assertAlmostEqual(
                self.observation[start + 2],
                space.fortified_village_modifier
                / MAX_FORTIFIED_VILLAGE_MODIFIER,
                msg=f"Incorrect fortified village modifier for {space.name}",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                self.observation[start + 3],
                0.0,
                msg=f"Reserved slot not zero for {space.name}",
            )
    def test_encode_map_state_german_control(self):
        space = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES[0]
        space.controlling_player = SideType.GERMAN
        encode_map_state(self.observation)
        start = self.get_space_start(space)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_map_state_allied_control(self):
        space = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES[0]
        space.controlling_player = SideType.ALLIED
        encode_map_state(self.observation)
        start = self.get_space_start(space)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_map_state_under_siege(self):
        space = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES[0]
        space.under_siege = True
        encode_map_state(self.observation)
        start = self.get_space_start(space)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_map_state_not_under_siege(self):
        space = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES[0]
        space.under_siege = False
        encode_map_state(self.observation)
        start = self.get_space_start(space)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start + 1],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_map_state_fortified_village_modifier(self):
        space = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES[0]
        space.fortified_village_modifier = 1
        encode_map_state(self.observation)
        start = self.get_space_start(space)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[start + 2],
            1 / MAX_FORTIFIED_VILLAGE_MODIFIER,
        )
    def test_encode_map_state_fortified_village_modifier_maximum(self):
        space = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES[0]
        space.fortified_village_modifier = (
            MAX_FORTIFIED_VILLAGE_MODIFIER
        )
        encode_map_state(self.observation)
        start = self.get_space_start(space)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[start + 2],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_map_state_reserved_slots_remain_zero(self):
        encode_map_state(self.observation)
        for space in GERMAN_MAP_SPACES:
            start = self.get_space_start(space)
            self.assertEqual(
                self.observation[start + 3],
                0.0,
                msg=f"Reserved slot not zero for {space.name}",
            )
    def test_encode_map_state_spaces_are_independent(self):
        first_space = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES[0]
        second_space = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES[1]
        first_space.controlling_player = SideType.GERMAN
        first_space.under_siege = True
        first_space.fortified_village_modifier = 1
        second_space.controlling_player = SideType.ALLIED
        second_space.under_siege = False
        second_space.fortified_village_modifier = (
            MAX_FORTIFIED_VILLAGE_MODIFIER
        )
        encode_map_state(self.observation)
        first_start = self.get_space_start(first_space)
        second_start = self.get_space_start(second_space)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[first_start],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[first_start + 1],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self.observation[first_start + 2],
            1 / MAX_FORTIFIED_VILLAGE_MODIFIER,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[first_start + 3],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[second_start],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[second_start + 1],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[second_start + 2],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[second_start + 3],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_map_state_only_changes_map_state_block(self):
        space = GERMAN_MAP_SPACES[0]
        space.controlling_player = SideType.GERMAN
        space.under_siege = True
        space.fortified_village_modifier = 1
        encode_map_state(self.observation)
        before_block = self.observation[
            :MAP_STATE_START
        ]
        after_block = self.observation[
            MAP_STATE_END:
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(before_block),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(after_block),
            0,
        )
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
import numpy as np
from core.german_units import (
    PZ_LEHR,
    SS_12,
    panzer_divisions_list,
)
from core.map.map_model import (
    in_transit_box,
    strategic_reserve_box,
    eliminated_units_box,
)
from core.map.map_spaces_brit_2 import bayeux
from core.ai.dqn.dqn_game_state_encoder import (
    OBSERVATION_SIZE,
    PANZERS_START,
    PANZERS_END,
    PANZER_FEATURES_PER_UNIT,
    NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT,
    LOCATION_NOT_AVAILABLE,
    LOCATION_IN_TRANSIT,
    LOCATION_STRATEGIC_RESERVE,
    LOCATION_ELIMINATED,
    GERMAN_LOCATION_INDEX,
    GERMAN_MAP_SPACES,
    encode_panzer_divisions,
)
class TestEncodePanzerDivisions(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        for space in GERMAN_MAP_SPACES:
            for panzer in panzer_divisions_list:
                if panzer in space.units:
                    space.units.remove(panzer)
        for box in [
            in_transit_box,
            strategic_reserve_box,
            eliminated_units_box,
        ]:
            for panzer in panzer_divisions_list:
                if panzer in box.units:
                    box.units.remove(panzer)
        for panzer in panzer_divisions_list:
            panzer.combat_value = 2
        self.observation = np.zeros(
            OBSERVATION_SIZE,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
    def test_encode_panzer_divisions_not_available(self):
        encode_panzer_divisions(self.observation)
        panzer_lehr_start = PANZERS_START
        location_state = self.observation[
            panzer_lehr_start:
            panzer_lehr_start + NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(location_state),
            1,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                panzer_lehr_start + LOCATION_NOT_AVAILABLE
            ],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_panzer_divisions_in_transit(self):
        in_transit_box.units.append(PZ_LEHR)
        encode_panzer_divisions(self.observation)
        panzer_lehr_start = PANZERS_START
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                panzer_lehr_start + LOCATION_IN_TRANSIT
            ],
            1.0,
        )
        location_state = self.observation[
            panzer_lehr_start:
            panzer_lehr_start + NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(location_state),
            1,
        )
    def test_encode_panzer_divisions_strategic_reserve(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(PZ_LEHR)
        encode_panzer_divisions(self.observation)
        panzer_lehr_start = PANZERS_START
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                panzer_lehr_start + LOCATION_STRATEGIC_RESERVE
            ],
            1.0,
        )
        location_state = self.observation[
            panzer_lehr_start:
            panzer_lehr_start + NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(location_state),
            1,
        )
    def test_encode_panzer_divisions_eliminated(self):
        eliminated_units_box.units.append(PZ_LEHR)
        encode_panzer_divisions(self.observation)
        panzer_lehr_start = PANZERS_START
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                panzer_lehr_start + LOCATION_ELIMINATED
            ],
            1.0,
        )
        location_state = self.observation[
            panzer_lehr_start:
            panzer_lehr_start + NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(location_state),
            1,
        )
    def test_encode_panzer_divisions_map_location(self):
        bayeux.units.append(PZ_LEHR)
        encode_panzer_divisions(self.observation)
        panzer_lehr_start = PANZERS_START
        bayeux_location_index = GERMAN_LOCATION_INDEX[id(bayeux)]
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                panzer_lehr_start + bayeux_location_index
            ],
            1.0,
        )
        location_state = self.observation[
            panzer_lehr_start:
            panzer_lehr_start + NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(location_state),
            1,
        )
    def test_encode_panzer_divisions_full_strength(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(PZ_LEHR)
        PZ_LEHR.combat_value = 2
        encode_panzer_divisions(self.observation)
        panzer_lehr_reduced_index = (
            PANZERS_START + NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[panzer_lehr_reduced_index],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_panzer_divisions_reduced_strength(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(PZ_LEHR)
        PZ_LEHR.combat_value = 1
        encode_panzer_divisions(self.observation)
        panzer_lehr_reduced_index = (
            PANZERS_START + NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[panzer_lehr_reduced_index],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_panzer_divisions_second_panzer_uses_next_block(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(PZ_LEHR)
        bayeux.units.append(SS_12)
        PZ_LEHR.combat_value = 2
        SS_12.combat_value = 1
        encode_panzer_divisions(self.observation)
        panzer_lehr_start = PANZERS_START
        ss_12_start = (
            PANZERS_START + PANZER_FEATURES_PER_UNIT
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                panzer_lehr_start + LOCATION_STRATEGIC_RESERVE
            ],
            1.0,
        )
        bayeux_location_index = GERMAN_LOCATION_INDEX[id(bayeux)]
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                ss_12_start + bayeux_location_index
            ],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                panzer_lehr_start + NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT
            ],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[
                ss_12_start + NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT
            ],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_panzer_divisions_every_panzer_has_one_location(self):
        encode_panzer_divisions(self.observation)
        for panzer_index in range(len(panzer_divisions_list)):
            start = (
                PANZERS_START
                + panzer_index * PANZER_FEATURES_PER_UNIT
            )
            location_state = self.observation[
                start:start + NAMED_UNIT_LOCATION_COUNT
            ]
            self.assertEqual(
                np.count_nonzero(location_state),
                1,
                msg=(
                    f"{panzer_divisions_list[panzer_index].name} "
                    f"does not have exactly one encoded location"
                ),
            )
    def test_encode_panzer_divisions_only_changes_panzer_block(self):
        strategic_reserve_box.units.append(PZ_LEHR)
        bayeux.units.append(SS_12)
        SS_12.combat_value = 1
        encode_panzer_divisions(self.observation)
        before_panzers = self.observation[:PANZERS_START]
        after_panzers = self.observation[PANZERS_END:]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(before_panzers),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(after_panzers),
            0,
        )
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
import numpy as np
from core.global_game_state import GlobalGameState
from core.map.map_model import (
    transport_track,
    supply_track,
    hitler_approval_track,
)
from core.ai.dqn.dqn_game_state_encoder import (
    OBSERVATION_SIZE,
    RESOURCES_START,
    RESOURCES_END,
    TRANSPORT_INDEX,
    SUPPLY_INDEX,
    HITLER_APPROVAL_INDEX,
    TRANSPORT_BASE_INDEX,
    SUPPLY_BASE_INDEX,
    HITLER_APPROVAL_BASE_INDEX,
    ACTIONS_LEFT_INDEX,
    RESERVE_ACTIONS_INDEX,
    encode_resources,
)
class TestEncodeResources(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        transport_track.value = 5
        supply_track.value = 4
        hitler_approval_track.value = 6
        GlobalGameState.transport_base_level = 3
        GlobalGameState.supply_base_level = 3
        GlobalGameState.hitler_approval_base_level = 3
        GlobalGameState.actions_left_this_turn = 0
        GlobalGameState.reserve_actions = 0
        self.observation = np.zeros(
            OBSERVATION_SIZE,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
    def test_encode_resources_current_values(self):
        transport_track.value = 3
        supply_track.value = 3
        hitler_approval_track.value = 2
        encode_resources(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[TRANSPORT_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[SUPPLY_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_APPROVAL_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
    def test_encode_resources_minimum_values(self):
        transport_track.value = 0
        supply_track.value = 0
        hitler_approval_track.value = -2
        encode_resources(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[TRANSPORT_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[SUPPLY_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_APPROVAL_INDEX],
            0.0,
        )
    def test_encode_resources_maximum_values(self):
        transport_track.value = 6
        supply_track.value = 6
        hitler_approval_track.value = 6
        encode_resources(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[TRANSPORT_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[SUPPLY_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_APPROVAL_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_resources_base_levels(self):
        GlobalGameState.transport_base_level = 3
        GlobalGameState.supply_base_level = 3
        GlobalGameState.hitler_approval_base_level = 2
        encode_resources(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[TRANSPORT_BASE_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[SUPPLY_BASE_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[HITLER_APPROVAL_BASE_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
    def test_encode_resources_actions_left(self):
        GlobalGameState.actions_left_this_turn = 2
        encode_resources(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[ACTIONS_LEFT_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
    def test_encode_resources_actions_left_maximum(self):
        GlobalGameState.actions_left_this_turn = 4
        encode_resources(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[ACTIONS_LEFT_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_resources_reserve_actions(self):
        GlobalGameState.reserve_actions = 1
        encode_resources(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[RESERVE_ACTIONS_INDEX],
            0.5,
        )
    def test_encode_resources_reserve_actions_maximum(self):
        GlobalGameState.reserve_actions = 2
        encode_resources(self.observation)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.observation[RESERVE_ACTIONS_INDEX],
            1.0,
        )
    def test_encode_resources_only_changes_resources_block(self):
        encode_resources(self.observation)
        before_resources = self.observation[:RESOURCES_START]
        after_resources = self.observation[RESOURCES_END:]
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(before_resources),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            np.count_nonzero(after_resources),
            0,
        )
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
